paraphrase: One should not insist on 'one-calling' or 'many-calling' as the true teaching; the nenbutsu of the primal vow includes both, and to set one against the other goes against the teaching. 'Immediately attaining birth' means that at the moment shinjin arises one dwells in non-retrogression, without waiting for another time or another day.
speaker: Shinran
